use proc_macro::TokenStream;
#[path = "../shared_macro.rs"]
mod shared;
include!("../included_macro.rs");

#[proc_macro]
pub fn fallible(_input: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
    assert!(shared::ready() && compiled_helper::ready() && included_ready());
    "pub fn macro_leaf() -> Result<u32, std::io::Error> { Ok(9) }"
        .parse()
        .expect("static valid Rust tokens")
}
